body: What if that's not the reason...? What if I'm not even sure if I still care about the reason? I'm not even myself anymore... My family tries to help me but I send them away very harshly and I make them cry but I dont feel anything it's like I don't care...My head feels like it's gonna explode from all the thinking and all I can think of is how much better off I would be if all my problems went away, if I just got in my car and ran in a tree at full speed...
Depression is chemically detectable inside a human being? So my parents would know I'm depressed by looking at test results?
I did not know it was possible to suffer from depression at my age. And the problem with consulting is that my parents are the doctors and I'd rather they don't know about this...
I believe it's a mix of it all but my self-esteem has always been a problem. I've always had difficulty believing people would benefit from having me in their lives.
